title: Sea level rise; transportation projects.
bodyText: The department of transportation shall plan for sea level rise based upon the latest science, estimates, and recommendations of the Hawaii climate change mitigation and adaptation commission in all future or amended transportation projects.
bodyHtml: [§279C-1]  Sea level rise; transportation projects.  The department of transportation shall plan for sea level rise based upon the latest science, estimates, and recommendations of the Hawaii climate change mitigation and adaptation commission in all future or amended transportation projects. [L 2022, c 299, pt of §1]
